A '''SuperFlow IV''' [[Droid brain/Legends|droid brain]] was a type of central [[Computer/Legends|computer]] for [[Starship/Legends|starships]] produced by [[Hanx-Wargel/Legends|Hanx-Wargel]], a starship technology corporation. The [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] designated [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|492727ZED]] was fitted with one by its manufacturer, [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering]], during its construction in [[60 BBY/Legends|60 BBY]]. It maintained a record of the ship's travels, its registrations, and its many upgrades. Various pilots of the craft also recorded their thoughts within it. A mechanic, [[Bammy Decree/Legends|Bammy Decree]], downloaded the craft's records and the pilots' messages while analyzing the brain in [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], after the ship collided with another, the ''[[Jendirian Valley III]]'', and the brain needed to be replaced. They were being sold by the company under warranty by Hanx-Wargel, but the part was very expensive.<ref name="MF">[[Millennium Falcon (novel)|''Millennium Falcon'']]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Superflow IV droid brain appeared in [[Millennium Falcon (novel)|''Millennium Falcon'']] by [[James Luceno]].
